elaine (Docs): Hey team — PR #482 is blocked on a couple of technical clarifications before I can push the docs preview and request a review. Two parts: (1) API/SDK behavior around streaming vs non-streaming defaults, and (2) CI docs preview link-check is failing for an autoscale anchor. Can people chime in?

sam (DevEx): dropping in to triage. Which SDK snippet is wrong? I can update once we confirm expected behavior. :+1:

elaine (Docs): The python example under /api/chat currently shows:
```python
resp = client.chat.create("gpt-redwood-v1", messages, streaming=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text)
```
But the REST portion says the query param is `stream` and defaults to false. Need to confirm whether the official SDK uses `streaming` or `stream`, and whether examples should show streaming by default or not. Also the docs preview fails with link-check: /dedicated/config#autoscale -> 422 redirect.

marco (Eng Runtime): short answer: SDK uses `stream` under the hood. The old wrapper accepted `streaming` in early betas but we removed that alias in v2. The assert: default is stream=false server-side. If you call the SDK helper with streaming=True it's doing a kwargs rename but I think the current published SDK no longer accepts `streaming`. So snippet is stale.

jess (Eng ML): adding that we changed batch defaults in the runtime last quarter — unrelated to streaming but docs should call out `max_batch_size` default=1 for low-latency routes. Otherwise folks will be surprised by throughput behavior when they toggle streaming.

sam (DevEx): ok removing `streaming=True` and using `stream=True` in python snippet. Also add a short note about `max_batch_size` default. Will open a follow-up docs PR to adjust code samples and callouts.

ci-bot: "link-check failed: GET https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/config#autoscale returned 302 -> 422 at 1749000122"

ryan (Eng Platform): that 302->422 means the internal redirect to /dedicated/capacity is returning a broken anchor. We changed the anchor name in 2025. Fix options: (A) update docs link to /dedicated/capacity#autoscale-policy or (B) re-add backwards-compatible anchor on old page. Which do you prefer?

elaine (Docs): prefer updating the link in the docs to the canonical path (Brittany did a rename). But we should also add a short redirect on the site for old links; I'll file infra ticket if platform agrees.

ryan (Eng Platform): agree. I'll add a short redirect rule. For the docs patch we should point to /dedicated/capacity#autoscale-policy.

marco (Eng Runtime): one more detail: streaming endpoints emit chunked SSE frames and the python SDK exposes an iterator when `stream=True`. Example we should copy into the docs: 
```python
with client.chat.stream(model="gpt-redwood-v1", messages=messages) as stream:
    for event in stream:
        if event.type == "delta":
            print(event.delta_text, end="")
```
Use `client.chat.create(..., stream=True)` also works but `stream()` context manager is preferred for cleanup.

sam (DevEx): I will swap to the `stream()` example and keep the short `create(..., stream=True)` snippet as an alternative.

elaine (Docs): CI-wise, once we update the link and the snippet, can someone re-run the docs preview?

ci-bot: queued docs-preview job #9821 (sha: abc123). Link-check will re-run.

jess (Eng ML): small note for the migration guide: call out the runtime incompatibility if someone tries `streaming=True` with older SDKs — add a one-liner upgrade note and sample sed command: `git grep -l "streaming=True" | xargs sed -i "s/streaming=True/stream=True/g"`

elaine (Docs): thanks. Reviewers — who can +1 once preview is green? I need an eng runtime review (marco) and a devex review (sam). Also product wants to schedule the merge window.

emma (Product): prefer merge after 12:00 PST so we don't surprise customers during EU morning. Can we aim for 12:30 PST?

marco (Eng Runtime): I'll give a quick review once CI is green, ETA ~20m after preview finishes.

sam (DevEx): same, I'll review content/phrasing. ETA ~15m after preview.

deploy-bot: reminder: docs merges between 12:00-13:00 PST will trigger full site rebuild.

elaine (Docs): perfect. I'll update the PR with the snippet and link change now and ping when preview comes back. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

ci-bot: docs-preview #9821 passed link-check at 1749000348

elaine (Docs): preview is green. @marco @sam can you review now? :eyes:

marco (Eng Runtime): reviewed and approved. small nit about wording on context manager, fixed in a one-line suggestion.

sam (DevEx): approved. I also expanded the migration note into a short checklist.

elaine (Docs): merging at 1749000360 per schedule (post-12:30 PST). Thanks all! :shipit:
